meta.name: team-release
meta.description: 编排发布团队：协调 release-manager、qa-lead、devops-engineer 和 producer，从候选版本到部署执行完整发布流程。

copy.tagline: 协调团队完成软件发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理从候选版本到部署的完整发布流程。
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate your team to complete software releases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage the full release process from candidate to deployment.

howto.what: Claude 会编排发布团队，协调 release-manager、qa-lead、devops-engineer 和 producer 四个角色，从候选版本到部署执行完整的发布流程，包括规划、质量门禁、放行决策和部署。
howto.when: 当你调用该技能时触发，通常你会提供版本号或指定 'next' 来启动发布流程。

say.text: 开始 1.2.3 版本的发布流程。
为下一个版本创建候选版本。
say.note: 执行阶段2：候选版本创建。
并行运行 QA 和 DevOps 测试。

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates a release team with roles: release-manager, qa-lead, devops-engineer, and producer, executing the full release pipeline from release candidate to deployment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you invoke the skill, usually by providing a version number or 'next' to start the release process.

say_en.text: Start the release process for version 1.2.3.
Create a release candidate for the next version.

say_en.note: Runs QA and DevOps tests in parallel.
